details.description: Document required environment (Node.js) and basic setup (npm install).
details.why_required: Developers need to know to use Node.js/npm before running the CLI.
details.code_evidence: package.json (script uses node); src/input.js lines 1-3 (CommonJS require, process.argv)

details.description: Explain how to run tasks via `node src/input.js <taskName>` and note that `npm start` points to a missing `src/index.js`.
details.why_required: Without this, `npm start` fails and developers cannot run any task.
details.code_evidence: package.json (start: node src/index.js); src/input.js lines 1-9 (CLI parses taskName and runs task)

details.description: List available tasks (`build`, `test`) and what they do.
details.why_required: Developers need to know which task names are valid and their effects.
details.code_evidence: src/tasks.js lines 1-7 (exports build/test functions that log actions)

details.description: Document expected errors for missing or unknown tasks.
details.why_required: Clarifies failure modes so callers can handle or avoid them.
details.code_evidence: src/input.js lines 5-7 (throws when task name missing); src/taskRunner.js lines 6-8 (throws on unknown task)

details.description: Describe module roles (CLI → runner → tasks) and how to add new tasks.
details.why_required: Helps maintainers extend the task set correctly.
details.code_evidence: src/input.js (delegates to runTask); src/taskRunner.js (resolves task by name); src/tasks.js (task registry)
